summary: Data-curation audit of runs/runs.json (26 runs, sum 534,555 events) against data/DATA/, data/download/, per-run DAQ run_metadata.json files, and Output/run_12/FINDINGS.md. VERIFIED CLEAN: all 26 registered file paths resolve (3 via symlinks, all valid); every registry event count matches both the DAQ metadata and in-file TTree entries for 10 files spot-checked with ROOT (including all four merged files: run_2223=2,263=22+23; run_2526=10,264=25+26; run_9001=26,028; run_2829=46,028=28+29); all registry timestamps match DAQ epoch values where both exist; timeline ordering is sane throughout. MAIN FLAGS a preservation board would raise: (1) registry+FINDINGS record wrong XCET pressures for EJ199 runs 39-41 ("single ~0.4 bar fill" vs DAQ-recorded 0.593/0.593 and 0.452/0.439); (2) run 27's registry note quotes numbers the campaign log explicitly superseded; (3) two derived ROOT files (run_2829.root, run_29good.root, ~2.1 GB) have zero documented provenance and run_9001 has no registry entry; (4) no checksums/fixity manifest anywhere, with un-hashed duplicate copies of runs 15/25/26; (5) shashlik-architecture correction only partially propagated into the registry despite FINDINGS claiming "registry language corrected throughout"; (6) run-number gaps 13, 16-21 unexplained anywhere; (7) systematic mean-vs-median timing drift between registry notes and adopted campaign numbers; (8) capillary serials, biases, and several XCET pressures live only in DAQ metadata (LuAG capillary serials recorded nowhere at all).

findings.item: Registry XCET pressures for EJ199 runs 39-41 contradict the DAQ metadata
findings.detail: runs.json notes for runs 39/40/41 (lines 275, 288, 301) and FINDINGS.md line 618 claim a 'single ~0.4 bar XCET fill for all three positive energies'. The DAQ metadata records XCET40/43 = 0.593/0.593 bar for run 39 (data/DATA/EJ199_1GEV-2026-08-30-120816/run_metadata.json) and run 40 (EJ199_3GEV-.../run_metadata.json), but 0.452/0.439 bar for run 41 (EJ199_5GEV-.../run_metadata.json) — neither single nor ~0.4. Physics survives (0.452 < 0.518 bar mu threshold at 5 GeV; 0.593 is fine at 1/3 GeV) but the +5 GeV purity margin is 13% below mu threshold, not the ~23% the registry implies, and the recorded beamline conditions are simply wrong for three runs. NEW finding.
findings.fix: Replace the three notes with the metadata values (39/40: 0.593/0.593; 41: 0.452/0.439), delete the 'single setting' claim, and add a corresponding correction entry to FINDINGS.md. Recompute the stated purity margin for run 41.

findings.item: Run 27 registry note quotes superseded (retired) results
findings.detail: runs.json line 126 states coincidence 1.74% (347 e), '~2.3% e- content x ~60-75% tag eff', peak 4400+/-97, shower-time 242+/-28 ps. FINDINGS.md '7 GeV recount' (lines 332-342) explicitly retires all of these: the 150-ADC threshold was a cut artifact; correct values are 8.77% coincidence at thr 40, beam ~9% electrons (superseding the 2.3% table value), 1,200 e on module, peak 4874+/-48, shower-time 223+/-9 (mean; adopted median 191+/-7). The registry is the first thing a future analyst reads and it currently contradicts the campaign log. NEW finding.
findings.fix: Rewrite run 27's note with the recount numbers and add 'superseded: initial thr-150 pass gave 347 e / peak 4400 — see FINDINGS 7 GeV recount'.

findings.item: Derived files run_2829.root and run_29good.root have no documented provenance; run_9001.root has no registry entry
findings.detail: data/download/run_2829.root (1.46 GB; verified 46,028 entries = plain concat of runs 28+29 pre-DQ) is read by macros/DriftStudy.C (lines 67-454) and macros/XCETScanPlot.C line 28 but appears nowhere in runs.json. data/download/run_29good.root (636 MB; verified 20,000 entries = run 29 DQ-good slices) is referenced by NOTHING — a fully orphaned file. run_9001.root is described only inside run 29's note (runs.json line 146) with no file path, tree, or entry of its own, and the exact slice-boundary definition (slices 0/1/4/6 of how many, by trigger_time_tag?) plus the merge commands (hadd?) are unrecorded. Risk: a future analyst uses the un-DQ'd run_2829 for physics, or deletes run_29good not knowing what it is. NEW finding (run_9001's composition, 26,028 events, IS documented in FINDINGS line 361-362 and matches the file).
findings.fix: Add a 'derived_files' section to runs.json (or a DERIVED.md next to the files) listing run_2223/2526/2829/9001/29good with parent runs, event counts, selection applied, creating macro/command, and intended use ('2829 = QC/drift studies only, NOT for physics').

findings.item: No checksums or fixity manifest; duplicate un-hashed copies with inconsistent canonical paths
findings.detail: find over the workspace returns zero .md5/.sha/manifest files. Primary data lives in Dropbox (sync-mutable). run_15.root, run_25.root, run_26.root each exist twice (data/download/ AND data/DATA/RUN_LUAG_*/, identical sizes, differing mtimes e.g. run_25: Aug 28 20:15 vs 20:10) with no way to prove the copies are identical; the registry points at the download/ copies for runs 15/25/26 but at the DATA/ originals for runs 29-44, and at symlinks for 12/24/27/28 — three different conventions. Stray convenience symlinks data/run_12.root and data/run_30.root add a fourth access path. NEW finding.
findings.fix: Generate a SHA-256 manifest of every .root and run_metadata.json (one shasum -a 256 sweep, committed next to runs.json), deduplicate or symlink the run 15/25/26 copies, and settle one canonical-path convention (DATA/ originals) in the registry.

findings.item: Shashlik-architecture correction only partially propagated into runs.json
findings.detail: FINDINGS.md line 648 claims 'Site/registry language corrected throughout', but in runs.json the MODULE NOTE (corrected 2026-08-31) appears only in runs 39-41; runs 42/43/44 lack it. The 'crystal' field still reads bare 'LuAG' (runs 12/14/15) and 'DSB1' (runs 31-38) — pre-correction semantics implying the crystal is the module — while EJ199 entries use the corrected 'EJ199 capillaries in LYSO:Ce/W shashlik'. Runs 22-30 have no crystal/channel field at all. NEW finding.
findings.fix: Rename the field to 'capillary_set' (or normalize all values to 'X capillaries in LYSO:Ce/W shashlik'), add it to runs 22-30, and put one campaign-level module-architecture note at the top of runs.json instead of repeating it per-run.

findings.item: Registry timing notes systematically quote retired mean-combination values instead of adopted medians
findings.detail: FINDINGS (lines 411-431) adopted per-event MEDIAN combination campaign-wide, and containment-gated timing. runs.json still quotes: run 24 '300+/-6 ps' (unlabeled mean; adopted median 274+/-5), run 29/9001 '212+/-11' (post-gating adopted 189 median), run 37 'Mean timing 214+/-9' (FINDINGS median 156+/-8), run 42 '347+/-14' (median 278+/-10), run 43 '325+/-23' (median 249+/-17). Registry run 30 additionally quotes 'standalone timing (mean combo) 328+/-28 ps, N=357' which matches nothing in FINDINGS (contained mean 547+/-32, median 227+/-32) and 'miss fraction 41.5%' vs FINDINGS' 54% — two irreconcilable numbers for the same run. NEW finding.
findings.fix: One pass over runs.json notes replacing every timing number with the adopted contained-median value (labeled 'median, ref included') and reconciling run 30's miss fraction and standalone timing against FINDINGS or deleting them.

findings.item: EJ199 result numbers in registry disagree with FINDINGS for runs 39-41
findings.detail: Run 41 registry (runs.json line 301): 'Peak ~2440 => ~490 ADC-eq/GeV (dimmest module)'; FINDINGS line 619-620: '5 GeV 2740+/-74 (~550 ADC-eq/GeV)'. Run 40 registry t-med 666+/-14 vs FINDINGS 626+/-13 at 3 GeV; run 41 registry 432+/-17 vs FINDINGS 380+/-18. Likely an early quick-pass vs final contained fit, but the registry and the campaign log now quote different values for the same quantities with no cross-reference; the '~490 vs ~550' spread also propagates into the campaign summary's '~550-650 ADC-eq/GeV' range. NEW finding.
findings.fix: Re-quote runs 39-41 notes from the final EnergyScanEJ199.C outputs and mark superseded quick-pass numbers as such.

findings.item: XCET pressures missing from registry (or drifted) where DAQ metadata records them; unrecorded entirely for runs 12-26
findings.detail: Run 31 registry still says 'presumably 0.062/0.060 - verify from spectra' although its own run_metadata.json records exactly 0.062/0.060 — the placeholder was never closed. Pressures present in metadata but absent from registry: run 32 (0.149/0.146), run 33 (0.206/0.194), run 35 (1.313/1.303 — analytically relevant: only ~9% below the 1.44 bar mu threshold at 3 GeV), run 38 (0.406/0.406). Drifted values: run 34 registry '1.5 bar' vs metadata 1.314/1.304 (FINDINGS also says 1.5; conclusion unchanged but numbers disagree); run 37 '0.400/0.405' vs metadata 0.406/0.406; run 42 '0.21' vs metadata 0.225/0.220. Run 36 registry 'XCET40 bled 11 -> 4 bar' conflates XCET43's static 4.123 bar with XCET40's post-bleed pressure (FINDINGS line 514: bled to ~3 bar) and omits XCET43 entirely. For runs 12-26 (all LuAG 1/3/5 GeV points + tests) no XCET pressure is recorded anywhere — the metadata experiment block only exists from run 31 on. NEW finding (run 34's tag invalidity itself is documented; the 1.5-vs-1.31 number is not).
findings.fix: Copy the metadata experiment-block pressures verbatim into every registry entry (runs 31-44), correct 34/36/37/42, close run 31's 'presumably', and reconstruct runs 12-26 pressures from the e-log/FINDINGS where possible, explicitly marking 'unrecorded' where not.

findings.detail: Grep over runs.json, FINDINGS.md, index.html, and run_summary.html finds no explanation for missing runs 13 and 16-21 (nor a note that runs 1-11 predate the registry). No files for these runs exist in data/DATA/ or data/download/. Seven consecutive missing run numbers (16-21) with no annotation is exactly what a preservation board reads as 'possibly lost data'. Presumably aborted/junk DAQ starts, but that must be stated. NEW finding.
findings.fix: Add a top-level 'unregistered_runs' map to runs.json: {13: reason, 16-21: reason, 1-11: 'commissioning, pre-campaign'} — one line each from the operators' memory while it is fresh.

findings.item: Runs 22/23 have no preserved DAQ metadata and an unresolved beam-energy caveat
findings.detail: No run_metadata.json, no DATA/ folder, no timestamps exist for runs 22/23 (the only two runs with zero DAQ provenance); registry entries carry no record_length/post_trigger/run_name/crystal. FINDINGS line 294 flags 'Caveat: confirm runs 22/23 were 5 GeV' (the MCP-threshold composition comparison assumed same-energy) while the registry asserts '3 GeV (per James)'. The 3 GeV reading is well supported (run 22/23 coincidences 25.9/21.8% match run 24's 23.5% at 3 GeV) but then the FINDINGS interpretation that the 240 mV trigger 'preferentially rejected electrons' (9.1%->25.9%) is partly confounded by the 5->3 GeV energy change — the caveat was never closed on either side. NEW finding.
findings.fix: Close the loop: state 3 GeV as confirmed in both files, annotate the FINDINGS composition section that the r15-vs-r22/23 comparison mixes a threshold change with an energy change, and reconstruct run 22/23 timestamps from file mtimes (Aug 28 ~16:05/16:12 UTC) marked as approximate.

findings.item: Capillary serials, corner mapping, and absolute biases exist only in DAQ metadata; LuAG capillary serials recorded nowhere
findings.detail: From run 31 onward, run_metadata.json records cap TL/TR/LL/LR serials (DSB1 T093/T091/T096/T099; EJ199 132/131/133/134) plus SiPM 29 V / Amp 7 V / MCP 3000 V. None of this reaches runs.json. The LuAG runs (12-30) predate the experiment block, so the LuAG capillary serial numbers and corner placement are recorded NOWHERE in the workspace — hardware traceability for the flagship dataset depends on memory. Registry bias info is only relative ('+1 V vs runs 12-14'). NEW finding.
findings.fix: Add capillary_serials (with corner map) and bias fields to each registry entry; reconstruct the LuAG set from lab records now, before the physical capillaries are re-sorted.

findings.item: Stale 'Beam' fields in DAQ metadata for runs 37 and 43 (registry correct, raw metadata wrong)
findings.detail: data/DATA/DSB1_5GEV-2026-08-29-234315/run_metadata.json experiment block says 'Beam: 1 GeV' for run 37 (actually +5 GeV; its own note says re-running 5 GeV) and EJ199_9GEV-2026-08-30-134259/run_metadata.json says 'Beam: -7 GeV' for run 43 (actually -9; its note field says -9 GeV). The experiment block is evidently carried over between runs and edited late. Any future auto-ingest trusting it would mislabel two runs; nothing anywhere flags these two fields as wrong. NEW finding.
findings.fix: Add a one-line 'metadata_errata' note to the run 37 and 43 registry entries stating the experiment-block Beam value is stale and the registry value is authoritative. Do not edit the raw DAQ files.

findings.item: Registry timestamps missing for runs 14 and 24-29 although DAQ metadata provides them
findings.detail: started_utc/ended_utc are absent from registry entries 14, 22-29. Metadata supplies them for all but 22/23: run 14 = 2026-08-28T10:55:10-11:00:48Z, run 24 = 16:13:13-16:39:29Z, run 25 = 16:57:06-17:48:23Z, run 26 = 18:16:43-19:13:36Z, run 27 = 20:42:50-21:34:57Z, run 28 = 21:40:16Z-, run 29 = 22:57:23Z-2026-08-29T06:57:11Z. All verified sane and monotone (run 29's overnight window also corroborates the 'worst in the morning' drift narrative). Where both registry and metadata have timestamps (runs 12, 15, 30-44) they agree exactly. NEW finding (the values above are ready to paste).
findings.fix: Copy the listed UTC values into runs.json.

findings.item: Channel-map provenance is fragmented across one registry entry and a note buried in another
findings.detail: A full channel_map exists only on run 12 (old array layout); the run>=14 layout lives solely in run 14's channel_map_note (runs.json line 52). Runs 15-44 rely on that buried note; runs 22/23 (no metadata) have no explicit layout statement at all, though they fall under 'run>=14'. The DAQ metadata does carry named per-channel maps with root_slot from run 15 on (e.g. DATA/RUN_LUAG_5_GeV/run_metadata.json 'channels' + 'root_channel_layout'), which is good ground truth, but the registry never points to it. The HG pairing (4-13, 5-12, 6-15, 7-14) similarly appears only in run 14's note and FINDINGS line 78. NEW finding.
findings.fix: Promote the two array layouts and the LG-HG pairing to a top-level 'formats' block in runs.json with per-run applicability ranges (12 = v1; >=14 = v2), and state explicitly that 22/23 are v2.

findings.item: Run 35 note 'post-fix collimator settings' contradicts the FINDINGS timeline
findings.detail: runs.json line 223 says run 35 (started 2026-08-29T18:06:53Z) ran 'at post-fix collimator settings', but the collimator/XCET-material fix happened MID-run-36, which started later (18:51:09Z) per both the registry's own run 36 note and FINDINGS' rate-mystery section. Run 35 was necessarily pre-fix. NEW finding.
findings.fix: Correct run 35's note (pre-fix tight-beam config) or specify which 'fix' is meant.

findings.item: Campaign event-total claim (~700k) vs registry sum 534,555
findings.detail: The registry's 26 runs sum to exactly 534,555 events (verified against in-file TTree entries for 10 files). The campaign summary circulates '~700k events'. The gap (~165k) is not explained by merged duplicates alone (2223+2526+2829+9001+29good add ~104k derived duplicates); it may include unregistered junk runs 13/16-21 or be a stale estimate. NEW cross-check.
findings.fix: Either quote 534,555 registered physics events, or footnote what the ~700k counts (e.g. including derived/aborted/duplicate triggers).

findings.item: Fragile filenames for irreplaceable early-run DAQ metadata
findings.detail: Run 12's only DAQ metadata is data/download/'run_metadata copy.json' (space in name, 'copy' suggests deletable); run 14's is the generically named data/download/run_metadata.json (overwrite-prone); run 15's is duplicated as download/run_metadata_Run15.json and DATA/RUN_LUAG_5_GeV/run_metadata.json. Registry array order also lists runs 25, 26 before 24. NEW finding.
findings.fix: Rename to run12_metadata.json / run14_metadata.json, and sort the registry array by run number.
